title: A smoother, safer Jellydash
summary: This patch fixes fresh SQLite installs, makes History totals accurate across every page, and cleans up a handful of small but annoying edge cases.
highlights: Fresh SQLite containers now create the database with the right ownership, so the web app can write to it from the first start.
History watch time, unique users, and transcoding totals now cover the complete active filter instead of only the current page.
Statistics keep all 12 month buckets at month end, and Windows library exclusions handle path casing correctly.
Now Playing leaves its loading state when Jellyfin is unavailable and keeps retrying quietly in the background.
